title: Gate dev with required checks: add plugin validate and Tracker integrity CI jobs and a dev ruleset
description: Dispatched by opum-agent (design by opum-doc, operator-approved about 23:40Z via opum-doc). diagram-skills ci.yml on dev has two jobs, diagram gate and lore check, and the repository has NO rulesets, so nothing requires those jobs and the pipeline lacks two standard checks. Add two jobs: plugin validate (claude plugin validate .), copied from the housekeeping-skills ci.yml plugin-validate job; and Tracker integrity (quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude), shaped from the opum-agent ci.yml job named Tracker integrity (read by ref via gh api, never from the filesystem). Land both through a PR into dev with all four contexts green on the PR head. Then prove the gate both ways on throwaway, unmerged branches. Then draft a new ruleset on refs/heads/dev requiring exactly the four contexts with no bypass actors, in the shape of housekeeping-skills ruleset 24613343, as one gh api -X POST step plus a read-back, and DO NOT RUN IT (a worker ruleset write is refused as Permission Grant; it goes to opum-doc and the operator). Promotion of dev to main is a later step, after the ruleset reads back active; no tag and no release, the marketplace pin stays at v0.1.0.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ci.yml on dev adds a plugin validate job (running claude plugin validate .) and a Tracker integrity job (running quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude), shaped from the housekeeping-skills plugin-validate job and the opum-agent Tracker integrity job; the existing diagram gate and lore check jobs are unchanged
The change lands through a PR into dev (opum-ai/diagram-skills#N) with all four contexts green on the PR head: diagram gate, lore check, plugin validate, Tracker integrity

Both directions are proven on throwaway branches that are deleted and never merged: a deliberate violation reddens its own job with the job log read for the exit code and message and every other job green, and a clean tree is green

A draft ruleset on refs/heads/dev requiring exactly diagram gate, lore check, plugin validate and Tracker integrity with no bypass actors is prepared as one gh api POST step plus a read-back and is NOT applied; it is reported to opum-agent for opum-doc and the operator to apply

implementationNotes: DSKI-17 overlap, recorded so a later reader does not rediscover it. (1) The lore check job has a step named Managed instructions are current that also runs quest agents --check (without --require-installed), so a drift in the managed block, or a broken tracker, reddens BOTH lore check and Tracker integrity. (2) Only --require-installed makes Tracker integrity unique: with the block MISSING, quest agents --check --require-installed exits 6 while the plain quest agents --check exits 0. Measured on runs 37553482659 (Tracker integrity red, exit 6, instruction block is missing; other three green) and 37553054750 (clean tree, all four green). (3) opum-doc ruled to keep it AS BUILT: the redundancy is red for true reasons, and the four-context shape matches the rest of the fleet. (4) No further hardening PR, per the operator ruling of 2026-10-05. Relay: opum-agent (team-lead), 2026-10-06.
finalSummary: DSKI-17 done. Added two jobs to diagram-skills ci.yml - plugin validate (claude plugin validate .) and Tracker integrity (quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude) - shaped from the housekeeping-skills plugin-validate job and the opum-agent Tracker integrity job. Landed through PR opum-ai/diagram-skills#18 (squash 8b7f59ea) with all four contexts green on the head. Proved the gate both ways on throwaway unmerged branches: a deliberate plugin.json violation reddened plugin validate alone (run 37552907413, exit 1, invalid JSON); a clean tree passed all four (run 37553054750); and a missing Quest block reddened Tracker integrity alone (run 37553482659, exit 6, instruction block is missing) with the other three green. Drafted the dev ruleset and did not apply it; the operator applied ruleset 24618758 dev required checks (4 contexts, 0 bypass actors), and I then promoted dev to main by fast-forward through PR opum-ai/diagram-skills#23 - origin/main equals origin/dev equals 32e3e52d74eb22fe5c444ee6413e73a8db77a37c. The implementation note records the overlap. Correction to that note: it gives the relay date as 2026-10-06; the opum-doc ruling was actually relayed at about 00:46Z on 2026-10-07 UTC.
